items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I tried to get in where Fred was. Fred was over at U of D out on Myers in Detroit. Fred Mergy, this guy that played like Rosolino or better.

ctx.x: Let’s flip back to Detroit. You mentioned Joe Henderson. So, just talk about your time at Wayne State and what was going on during that period.
Well, I tried to get in where Fred was. Fred was over at U of D out on Myers in Detroit.
